units.displayText: Nameless's grilled fish was quite good, and Sortie104 sang well too, though she went a bit overboard.

spans.text: Nameless's grilled fish was quite good, and Sortie104 sang well too, though she went a bit overboard.

units.rawText: Monitor104 must be worn out today. Just like you, one sip of liquor and she started mumbling.
units.displayText: Monitor104 must be worn out today. Just like you, one sip of liquor and she started mumbling.

spans.text: Monitor104 must be worn out today. Just like you, one sip of liquor and she started mumbling.

units.rawText: Olivia looked back. After the revelry, some Agents in Cyclopes were still drunk, lying on the ground together, Combat-types and Monitor-Types alike.
units.displayText: Olivia looked back. After the revelry, some Agents in Cyclopes were still drunk, lying on the ground together, Combat-types and Monitor-Types alike.

units.rawText: Zzz... Let the flowers bloom, zzz... scatter them across Magrasea's sky♪... zzz...
units.displayText: Zzz... Let the flowers bloom, zzz... scatter them across Magrasea's sky♪... zzz...

spans.text: Zzz... Let the flowers bloom, zzz... scatter them across Magrasea's sky♪... zzz...

units.rawText: I-I can still drink... zzz~
units.displayText: I-I can still drink... zzz~

spans.text: I-I can still drink... zzz~

units.rawText: Sortie104, you're off-key... Huh, why does Olivia have red hair now, and she's playing guitar... zzz...
units.displayText: Sortie104, you're off-key... Huh, why does Olivia have red hair now, and she's playing guitar... zzz...

spans.text: Sortie104, you're off-key... Huh, why does Olivia have red hair now, and she's playing guitar... zzz...

units.rawText: Such troublesome kids... But Tasha, I think you'd be happy to see how they've changed.
units.displayText: Such troublesome kids... But Tasha, I think you'd be happy to see how they've changed.

spans.text: Such troublesome kids... But Tasha, I think you'd be happy to see how they've changed.

units.rawText: You once told me not to reset you, because your dream had already come true.
units.displayText: You once told me not to reset you, because your dream had already come true.

spans.text: You once told me not to reset you, because your dream had already come true.

units.rawText: I thought so too back then. We'd broken the loop of slaughter, and Cyclopes was free...
units.displayText: I thought so too back then. We'd broken the loop of slaughter, and Cyclopes was free...

spans.text: I thought so too back then. We'd broken the loop of slaughter, and Cyclopes was free...

units.rawText: But now I think our dream has only just begun.
units.displayText: But now I think our dream has only just begun.

spans.text: But now I think our dream has only just begun.

units.rawText: Olivia drew the combat knife at her waist and raised it high.
units.displayText: Olivia drew the combat knife at her waist and raised it high.

spans.text: Olivia drew the combat knife at her waist and raised it high.

units.rawText: The battles ahead will be hard—both this defense of Magrasea and the growth of Cyclopes.
units.displayText: The battles ahead will be hard—both this defense of Magrasea and the growth of Cyclopes.

spans.text: The battles ahead will be hard—both this defense of Magrasea and the growth of Cyclopes.

units.rawText: But I believe these kids will overcome those hardships, and I'll move forward with them.
units.displayText: But I believe these kids will overcome those hardships, and I'll move forward with them.

spans.text: But I believe these kids will overcome those hardships, and I'll move forward with them.

units.rawText: On the next memorial day, we'll show you a Cyclopes that's even more different.
units.displayText: On the next memorial day, we'll show you a Cyclopes that's even more different.

spans.text: On the next memorial day, we'll show you a Cyclopes that's even more different.

units.rawText: Tasha, watch closely... We'll carry your will and march toward the future.
